opening: The Unordered Delivery. Someone announces a food delivery, but I ordered nothing. My sister shakes her head when asked, and my girlfriend fearfully does the same. As I am about to refuse it, several burly men rush in and pin me down.
reference_answer: The delivery worker is a disguised police officer. The room is used by a pyramid scheme, and I tricked my sister and girlfriend into joining it. My girlfriend secretly called the police for help. The men rushing in are officers arresting me.
canonical_solution: The delivery worker is a disguised police officer. The room is used by a pyramid scheme, and I tricked my sister and girlfriend into joining it. My girlfriend secretly called the police for help. The men rushing in are officers arresting me.
canonical_facts: The apparent delivery worker is an undercover police officer
The room is used for a pyramid scheme and the narrator tricked their sister and girlfriend into joining
The girlfriend secretly asked the police for help
The men who rush in are police arresting the narrator
explicit_negatives: The men are police arresting the deceptive recruiter, not burglars. The girlfriend, not the sister, made the specified call.
unknown_details: The narrator recruits the two women but being the founder or sole leader is not established. Clothing color and whether food was physically carried are unspecified.
completion_requirements: The apparent delivery worker is an undercover police officer
